'''Zotho Benex''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] and leader of a [[City/Legends|village]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ison/Legends|Ison]] named [[Haven (Ison)/Legends|Haven]]. He was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] sympathizer.<ref name="Rulebook" />
